Directions: Use the information to answer each question that follows.
Content: A student is indoors at school on a winter day in Oklahoma when they are surprised to learn from their teacher that in some parts of South America it is summertime.

They ask their teacher why the seasons are different between these locations and their teacher shows them a model of `text(Earth)` in relation to the `text(Sun)`. Their teacher explains that `text(Earth)` has a North Pole and a South Pole. `text(Earth)` also has `text(two)` different regions, or hemispheres: a Northern Hemisphere above the equator and a Southern Hemisphere below the equator. The diagram shows the equator and the poles and hemispheres of `text(Earth)`.

Oklahoma is in the Northern Hemisphere of `text(Earth)`, while some parts of South America are in the Southern Hemisphere. The model shows the position of `text(Earth)` relative to the `text(Sun)` when it is December.
The student also finds information about seasons at different times of the year in relation to `text(Earth’s)` hemispheres.
